title: How BJP Is TRANSFORMING West Bengal FOREVER | Suvendu Report Card
description:
In this video, we discuss the first month of Suvendu Adhikari as the Chief Minister of West Bengal. We look at the major steps taken by the BJP government during this period and how the political situation in the state is changing. We discuss claims that the TMC is facing internal divisions, with some leaders reportedly sidelining Mamata Banerjee.

We also cover the welfare programs that have been fast-tracked by the new government and the action being taken against illegal immigration, including the deportation of thousands of illegal immigrants. We discuss BJP's "Detect, Delete, and Deport" policy, the crackdown on illegal constructions in Kolkata, and the reopening of old corruption and violence cases linked to former TMC leaders. Finally, we analyze the government's efforts to strengthen border infrastructure and review its one-month report card.
